title: Cartel Count Up Slipped An Vibrant Single Track, "Trapping Like This"
htmlContent:
Cartel Count Up is a USA-based hip hop/autotune artist and producer. With catchy hooks and bouncy beats, Cartel Count Up brings a unique sound to the music industry. 

He recently dropped his hit single "Trapping Like This," which has taken the music scene by storm. The song has an upbeat, happy vibe, with autotuned and chill lyrics that make it the perfect summer track. 

After climbing the charts for weeks, the single went viral, inspiring fans worldwide to start waving their hands in the air. Together with the production team, Cartel Count Up made waves in hip-hop and trap music scenes. His success story is sure to inspire many listeners around the world.
